title: 8.35. Cittaduka
note: Pāli only: every English translation of the Abhidhamma is still under copyright, so no English can be shown yet. A free translation will be added if one becomes available.

verses.t: Nacittaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca nacitto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Nacittaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca nanocitto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Nacittaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca nacitto ca nanocitto ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā.
Nanocittaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca nacitto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā.
Nacittañca nanocittañca dhammaṁ paṭicca nacitto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. (Saṅkhittaṁ.)
